objectives.description: Add shared observable wrapper (duplicated inline in each of 4 files)
events-log-lifecycle.sh: replace 2 sites + remove early bypass guard
events-log-artifact.sh: replace 2 sites + remove early bypass guard
Verify with present/absent/failing helper harness across all 4 files

approaches_tried.approach: Bare helper invocation without an if-guard around the call inside _events_append_observable
approaches_tried.reason: Under set -e / set -euo pipefail (orchestrator-postflight.sh declares the latter), a present-but-failing helper's non-zero exit terminated the enclosing script before the wrapper could capture $? and return 0, defeating the never-fatal contract. Fixed by wrapping the call in an if/else.

deviations.description: Add the shared observable wrapper in a location sourced by both skill-base.sh and the hooks
deviations.reason: The plan offered a fallback ("duplicate a tiny inline guard if sourcing is not clean") which was taken: the 4 call-site files span sourced (skill-base.sh) and standalone (orchestrator-postflight.sh + 2 hooks) execution contexts with no existing shared-sourcing convention among them, and a new shared script file would require a manifest.json registration outside this task's edit-target file list. The identical function body is duplicated in each of the 4 files instead.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — duplicated inline per-file instead of a single sourced shared script)*
